hashMismatch: The downloaded {path} is not the published snout-stack file this version of the app expects (its SHA-256 does not match), so nothing was written or run. Try again later, or report it.
downloadHttp: Could not download the stack: {path}: HTTP {status}
templateNeedsBoth: A template needs a subject and a body.
templateNeedsLink: The template must include {{ .ConfirmationURL }} (or {{ .Token }}), or your users get an email with nothing to click.
templateUnmatched: The template has an unmatched {{ or }}.
secretName: A secret's name is letters, digits and underscores, and does not start with a digit.
secretReserved: Names starting SNOUTDATA_ or DENO_ are the platform's.
secretOneLine: A secret is one line. For a key file, store it base64 encoded and decode it in the function.
chooseFolder: Choose a folder for the project.
portRange: {label} must be a number from 1024 to 65535.
differentPorts: The API and the database need different ports.
siteUrlScheme: Site URL must start with http:// or https://.
ownS3: Without the bundled file store, give your own S3 endpoint, bucket and keys.
redirectNotAddress: {url} is not an address. Each redirect address starts with its scheme, like https://.
redirectComma: A redirect address cannot hold a comma.
fnMemory: A function's memory is between 64 and 4096 MB.
fnMemoryTotal: The functions together need at least 256 MB.
fnMemoryOver: One function cannot have more memory than all of them share.
callDuration: A call may run between 1 second and 1 hour.
callCpu: A call's CPU time is between 100 ms and 10 minutes.
addressScheme: The address must start with http:// or https:// and name a host.
publicHttps: A public address must be https://. Put a TLS proxy (Caddy, nginx) in front of the gateway.
dockerNotFound: The docker command was not found on this computer.
installEngineAdvice: Install Docker Engine and the Compose plugin, then check again. Podman works too when its docker command is installed.
installDesktopAdvice: Install Docker Desktop, start it once, then check again. Podman Desktop works too with its Docker compatibility switched on.
dockerNoAccess: Docker is running, but this account may not use it.
dockerNotRunning: Docker is installed but not running.
addToGroup: Add yourself to the docker group ("sudo usermod -aG docker $USER"), sign out and back in, then check again.
startDesktop: Start Docker Desktop and wait until it says it is running, then check again.
startSystemd: Start it ("sudo systemctl start docker"), then check again.
startEngine: Start your container engine, then check again.
composeMissing: The Compose plugin (docker compose) is not installed.
installPlugin: Install the docker-compose-plugin package, then check again.
updateDesktop: Docker Desktop includes it: update Docker Desktop, then check again.
composeOld: Compose {composeVersion} is installed; the stack needs {MIN_COMPOSE} or later.
updateDocker: Update Docker (or the Compose plugin), then check again.
memoryAdvice: The stack uses about 170 MB idle and about 360 MB under load, but pulling and starting it is happier with 2 GB or more. Raise it in Docker Desktop's settings (Resources) if setup is slow.
engineMemoryOk: The engine has {memory}; the stack uses about 170 MB idle and about 360 MB under load.
stackMemory: The stack uses about 170 MB idle and about 360 MB under load.
stackUnreachable: The published stack could not be reached{detail}.
networkAdvice: Setup downloads the stack's compose file from GitHub and its images (about 670 MB) from ghcr.io. Check the connection or proxy, then check again.
fnLink: {name} is a link, and a function is copied from its own folder only. Put the file itself there.
fnTooManyFiles: {folder} has more than {max} files, the most a function may hold.
fnTooBig: {folder} holds more than {max} KB, the most a function may. A function is source code; put large files in Storage.
fnNotText: {path} is not text, and a function is source code. Put binary files in Storage.
notListed: That local project is not in the list any more.
envMissing: {path} is missing. It held this project's keys; restore it from your backup to run the project again.
noDesktop: Docker Desktop is not installed where the app can start it. Start your container engine yourself.
startingDesktop: Starting Docker Desktop. This can take a minute.
unavailableStart: Docker is not running, so these projects' states cannot be read. Start Docker to run them.
unavailableInstall: Docker is not running, so these projects' states cannot be read. Install Docker to run them.
folderNotEmpty: {folder} is not empty. Choose a new or empty folder: the project's files go there.
portsBusyChoose: Port {ports} is already in use on this computer. Choose another.
composeNotExpected: The downloaded compose.yaml does not name the snout-stack image this version of the app expects. Try again later, or report it.
writeFiles: Could not write the stack's files: {error}
sayKeys: Making this project's keys and passwords
makeKeys: Could not make the project's keys: {detail}
sayPull: Downloading the images (about 670 MB the first time)
busy: Something is already happening to this project. Wait for it to finish.
isStopped: {name} is stopped. Its data is kept.
folderGone: Its folder is gone, so its data cannot be found to delete. Remove it from the list without deleting data.
fnName: A function name is letters, digits, dashes and underscores, and does not start with _.
fnCreated: functions/{name}/index.ts was created. Deploy to serve it.
deployed: Functions deployed. The runtime serves the new code at once.
ownOverrideApi: This project has a compose.override.yaml of your own, so the app leaves the data API to it.
switchNotApplied: The switch is saved, but Docker did not apply it: {detail}
dataApiOn: The data API is on: REST at {rest} and GraphQL at {graphql}.
dataApiOff: The data API is off. The rest of the project keeps running.
portsBusy: Port {ports} is already in use on this computer.
savedRestarted: Saved. The services that changed were restarted.
savedNotUp: Saved, but the stack did not come back up: {detail}
ownOverrideEmail: This project has a compose.override.yaml of your own, so the app cannot add the email templates to it.
templateSaved: Saved. Auth sends it from now on.
authNotRestarted: Saved, but auth did not restart: {detail}
secretRemoved: {name} was removed. Functions were deployed without it.
secretSet: {name} was set. Functions were deployed with it.
startFirstPassword: Start the project first: the password is changed in its running database.
passwordRefused: The database refused the new password: {detail}
newPassword: New password set.{said} Copy it from Database.
keysIssued: New keys issued. Every key pasted into an app or a secret stops working, and signed-in users sign in again.
keysNotUp: The new keys are in .env, but the stack did not come back up: {detail}
startFirstExport: Start the project first: the export is taken from the running database.
exported: Exported to {EXPORT_DIR}/{name}. Files in storage are not in it; they stay in the objects volume.
notInBackups: That export is not in the project's backups folder.
startFirstRestore: Start the project first: the restore runs in its database server.
sayRestoreBeside: Restoring the export beside the project's database
restoreFailed: Nothing was changed: the export did not restore. {detail}
swapFailed: The restored database could not be swapped in: {detail}
putBackCron: Put back to {name}, but its Cron jobs could not be restored: {detail}
restoredNotUp: Restored, but the stack did not come back up: {detail}
